name: acf-mission-control
description: Mission Control HUD for Claude Code - two-line status line with 1M-context-aware fuel gauge, per-model colors, session cost, 5h/7d rate limits, git dirty state, and a prompt-cache-warmth indicator. Prices the whole session itself from transcript token usage - main thread plus subagent/workflow transcripts - against the LiteLLM rate table (refreshed daily, provider prefixes stripped, speed multipliers applied), so proxied models Claude Code cannot price no longer read as $0.00. Sleek monochrome glyphs by default, themeable (sleek/emoji/nerd/text). Self-upgrading.
